loop.top3_why: The series is strongly trend‑dominated and the model ranking is unstable across windows. A robust, deterministic combination that relies on the subset of models with the most consistent ranking (trimmed_mean over pool1) is therefore preferable. Candidate A achieves a competitive validation score (0.6633) while showing the most stable per‑window performance and avoiding the high‑variance weight estimation of the full‑pool weighted approach.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (mean over pool1) has a higher overall score but its per‑window performance is more variable, reflecting the instability of the model ranking. Candidate C (weighted over the full pool) has the lowest gap to the best but relies on weights derived from a meta‑model trained on other series; with only three validation windows this introduces high variance and risk of over‑fitting. Given the trend‑dominated nature of the series, a robust trimmed‑mean approach is the safest choice.
